template_data.headline_html: Five ways small businesses price themselves out of federal awards.

items.title: Copy-paste your commercial rates
items.sub: GSA pricing is a negotiated contract — your Basis of Award ties it to your best commercial deal.

items.title: Ignore the Price Reduction Clause
items.sub: Discount a commercial client below GSA? Your Schedule rate must follow. Most don't track this.

items.title: Bundle what should be line items
items.sub: COs compare line-by-line. Bundled services vanish in procurement searches before anyone reads them.

items.title: Accept the CO's first counter-offer
items.sub: Pushback is normal — it's negotiation. Conceding too fast locks in a margin hit you carry for years.

items.title: Set outlier rates in GSA Advantage
items.sub: COs work within budget targets. Pricing outside the norm gets filtered before your name appears.
